messages:
anika: Heads-up — nightly eval runner hung on the new quantized checkpoint for ceres-7b when running the chat-template suite. CI timed out after 30m. eval-bot posted failure.

devin: ugh. saw this too. the runner process is still alive but no logs after model load. suspect KV-cache or tokenizer mismatch.

sam: can you paste the last few lines from the runner log? also which chat-template? the new 'compact_reply' one?

anika: compact_reply yes. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-04 03:12:21] INFO loading quantized weights: ceres-7b-q4f
[2026-03-04 03:12:28] INFO tokenizer init done (v2)
[2026-03-04 03:12:28] INFO chat-template compiled: compact_reply
[2026-03-04 03:12:28] WARN long_input detected: seq_len_estimate=16000
[2026-03-04 03:12:28] ERROR OOM check failed, entering safe-wait
```
runner stayed in safe-wait and never threw an exception.

mara: 16k?? we only sent a 512 char prompt. maybe tokenizer exploded. compact_reply has a leading ZERO-WIDTH JOINER trick to keep tokens aligned, right?

devin: yeah the template adds a ZWJ (‍) sequence to glue speaker tokens. looks like the updated tokenizer v2 treats the ZWJ+nbsp sequences as separate grapheme clusters -> huge token expansion.

leo: repro steps (what I ran locally):
```bash
# checkout eval-runner@fix-zwj-repro
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ./eval-runner[dev]
eval-runner run --model ceres-7b-q4f --template compact_reply --input samples/short_chat.json
```
Result: local runner logs show seq_len_estimate ~ 15000 and then stall.

sam: thanks. can you dump tokenizer.encode output for the prompt (first 50 tokens) and paste?

leo: pasted: `['▁Hello', '▁there', '‍', '▁User', '▁:', '▁How', '▁can', '▁I', '▁help', '▁you', ...]` — notes the ZWJ is a separate token and is repeated a lot because the template inserts it in front of each speaker token.

devin: bug hypothesis: tokenizer v2 was updated to preserve ZWJ as standalone token for Unicode correctness, but our collate/length-estimator assumes control chars are free. quant loader then builds KV cache shapes using the estimated length and when the estimate is huge we trip OOM guard and stall.

anika: immediate mitigation: revert template to remove explicit ZWJ insertion in compact_reply in CI (quick patch). longer fix: normalize template by removing ZWJ before tokenization or update tokenizer merge rules.

mara: I'll open a small PR to strip ZWJ in the template renderer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-templates/pull/342 (draft).

devin: also adding a guard in eval-runner: if seq_len_estimate > 4096 and model.qtype contains 'q4', fail fast with clear error and dump offending tokens. less silent safe-wait. I'll make a ticket and a follow-up PR.

sam: add a unit test in eval-harness that includes the ZWJ case. We need to catch token explosion in CI.

anika: created tracking issue in jira (ML-1784) and assigned to devin + mara. steps: 1) hotfix template (mara) 2) fail-fast guard (devin) 3) tokenizer policy decision (research) 4) postmortem + add chat-template lint rule.

leo: quick note: quantized model load path revealed another minor issue — q4 allocator doesn't free temp tensors on OOM path which left runner in safe-wait. I'll attach a small core dump and patch next.

eval-bot: CI notice: nightly run 2312345600 failed on eng-ml/eval-runner (timeout). Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/2312345600

anika: thanks everyone. for now I've reverted compact_reply in the nightly CI config and re-triggered. will follow up after PRs land. :thumbsup:
